title: Timed (6 min): two-pass method
prompt:
Set **6 minutes**. Implement `secondLargest(int[] arr)`: the second distinct largest, or -1 when it doesn't exist (empty, one element, all equal). Two passes are explicitly fine — the tie-break clause is the trap.

Log your phases afterward.

tests.name: second largest
tests.hint: Pass 1 finds the max; pass 2 finds the max among values strictly less than it.
